शौचं [शुचेर्भावः अण्]
1 Purity,
clearness; काके शौचं द्यूतकारे च सत्यं

.
--2 Purification from
personal defilement caused by
voiding excrement, but
particularly by the death of a
relative.
--3 Cleansing, purifying.
--4 Voiding of excrement.
--5
Uprightness, honesty.
--Comp.
--आचारः, --कर्मन् n.
--कल्पः a purificatory
rite.
--कूपः a privy.

1 A cleanser.
--2 N. of a
mixed tribe.

सौचिः, सौचिकः A tailor; Kull.
